deploy-bot: Deploy attempt queued — concurrency limit reached.
Environment: production
Tag: v2.12.0-canary

Estimated wait: ~4m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya: That's a canary for the billing edge fix, low risk.
Ryan: @Maya what's the change window? we have DB migration at 03:45 UTC.
Maya: change window 03:30-04:30 UTC. This canary needs to go before the migration.
Olga: Can we bump priority? this is a customer blocker for Billing team. :exclamation:
Samir: We can promote if someone cancels a non-urgent deploy or infra adds capacity.
Olga: @team @eng-releases anyone able to drop their deploy? pretty please. :pray:
Ryan: I'm mid-hotfix, ETA ~12m, can't cancel.
Samir: Infra might do a short burst. @infra-bot can we add a slot for 10m?
infra-bot: Request received. Autoscale policy: allow +1 burst for 10m with owner approval.
Maya: I approve burst +1 for 10 minutes to unblock this canary.
Samir: Approved. infra-bot, please execute.
infra-bot: Increasing concurrent deploy limit to 6 for 10 minutes. Change id: cb-20260320-77
deploy-bot: Slot freed. Deploy starting: v2.12.0-canary -> production
deploy-bot: Started at 1776004510 by Maya. Trace: https://ci.redwood/prod/deploy/9f3b2a7
Maya: Watching canary logs now. tail -f /var/logs/deploy/9f3b2a7.log
deploy-bot: Canary health checks passing (3/3) after 90s. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: latency +2% vs baseline, error rate 0.1% (baseline 0.08%)
Olga: Looks fine. Recommend proceed to 20% rollout.
Maya: Rolling to 20%.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 20% complete.
Ryan: Need to pin saga-service to v1.7.4 in this release to avoid runtime mismatch.
Maya: Done — pinned saga-service=1.7.4 in manifests and committed.
deploy-bot: Manifest update recorded: manifest@9f3b2a7 -> saga-service=1.7.4
deploy-bot: Full rollout scheduled. Completion ETA ~12m.
infra-bot: Auto-scaling cap will revert after 10 minutes (cb-20260320-77).
Samir: Observability shows no regressions so far.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished at 1776004990. Status: SUCCESS. Tag v2.12.0-canary promoted -> production
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes and notify Billing.
Samir: I'll add release note: "billing edge fix; pinned saga-service to 1.7.4" and close the ticket.
deploy-bot: Closing queue entry. Queue length now 0.
